title: sdks: unify auth/retries & streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go + parity bump v1.127.0
author: Ariel Kim
release_notes:
- Unified auth header handling and token refresh across Python/TS/Go SDKs
- Consistent retry semantics (idempotency, backoff) across SDKs
- Stabilized streaming client ergonomics and cancellation behavior
- Parity and minor API surface bumps to v1.127.0 for all SDKs
description:
Context: We have diverging auth/retry behavior and streaming ergonomics across the three official SDKs (python/typescript/go). This causes customer confusion and subtle production bugs (token refresh races, inconsistent retry on non-idempotent endpoints, streaming cancel/close semantics).

Goal: Align auth header logic, unify retry policy primitives and defaults, and standardize streaming client ergonomics while keeping backwards-compatible shims where possible. This PR groups the cross-language changes and bumps the SDK versions to v1.127.0 to signal parity.

What this PR does:
- SDK core: introduce a common retry contract (RetryPolicy) implemented idiomatically per language. Default policy: exponential backoff (base 100ms, max 30s), retry on 429/503/504 and connection errors, do not retry POSTs without idempotency token unless explicitly enabled.
- Auth: centralize token-refresh path to avoid races; all SDKs now attach Authorization: Bearer <token> at request time and guarantee only single in-flight refresh per credential.
- Streaming: consistent API for streaming responses and cancellation: client.close/cancel triggers graceful shutdown, on_close callback invoked exactly once, and server partial results are surfaced as a final error when applicable. Added ergonomic helpers for async iteration (python/ts) and context-managed streaming (go).
- Parity bumps: aligned method names and parameter names where feasible; added deprecation shims for renamed helpers with clear warnings. Bumped package versions: python (v1.127.0), typescript (v1.127.0), go (v1.127.0).
- Tests/examples: updated quickstarts and examples across three SDKs; added cross-language integration harness used by CI.

Testing & CI: Initial CI run showed a flaky streaming integration test in the TS pipeline (race on cancel). Fixed by deferring teardown until ack from server (commit: fix(ts): streaming cancel teardown handshake). All unit and integration jobs passed on re-run.

Rollout: Merge to main triggers the coordinated release pipeline which publishes wheels/npm modules/go modules in order (python -> typescript -> go) to minimize breakage. Releases are gated behind the changelog and release notes generated from this PR.

Notes and compatibility: We strove for backward compatibility; however, code that relied on previous streaming close semantics may need to adopt the new helpers. Deprecation warnings will be present for one release cycle. See the migration guide in sdk/*/MIGRATION.md added in this PR.
